Hi Marta — thanks for sending this over and for the CSV. Short answers up front: portal preferred; email fallback ok during provisioning; separate invoices per legal entity is easiest for us, but we can accept a combined invoice if every line contains the issuing entity and the PO number.

A few specifics from AP below so you can update your templates quickly:

- Required columns for automated PO matching: PO_NUMBER, INVOICE_DATE (YYYY-MM-DD), INVOICE_NUMBER, ENTITY_NAME, LINE_DESCRIPTION, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, TAX_AMOUNT, TOTAL_LINE_AMOUNT
- Optional but helpful: SHIP_TO_LOCATION, CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_CODE (Redwood internal GL mapping)
- For combined invoices: include ENTITY_NAME on each line and make sure totals match entity subtotals on page 1; our PO stamping will prefer one invoice = one PO per line but can map multiple POs if PO_NUMBER is present per line.

Portal vs email notes:
- Portal (recommended): idempotent uploads, auto-ack, faster PO match; please use CSV UTF-8 with header row exactly as above.
- Email fallback: subject must contain exact PO_NUMBER(s) and attach CSV; attach PDF version of invoice for archive. Invoices emailed without PO in subject will be routed to manual queue.

I'll copy Monica on the minimal schema and Vanessa to coordinate vendor portal enablement and escalation windows. I'll also upload a crosswalk template to Drive and link it below.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Manager, Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference

Hi Marta — quick operational notes from AP so your AR team can implement without surprises: 

- PO crosswalk: If you choose to send a combined invoice, please add a top-level summary table listing each ENTITY_NAME, ENTITY_TAX_ID, RELATED_PO, and SUBTOTAL. This speeds validation.
- PDF requirement: we store the PDF snapshot for audit. If you submit CSV via the portal, also attach a single-page PDF copy in the portal upload metadata or email a PDF if using email fallback.
- Currency & tax: include ISO currency code on each line (e.g., USD). If VAT applies for EU entity, include TAX_RATE and TAX_AMOUNT per line.

Sample minimal CSV header (exact column names):
PO_NUMBER,INVOICE_NUMBER,INVOICE_DATE,ENTITY_NAME,ITEM_CODE,LINE_DESCRIPTION,QUANTITY,UNIT_PRICE,CURRENCY,TAX_RATE,TAX_AMOUNT,TOTAL_LINE_AMOUNT,SHIP_TO_LOCATION

If you want, send one combined sample (CSV + PDF) and we'll run it through our ingest test in a staging portal to confirm PO match behavior. ETA for portal enablement once legal approves is 3–5 business days.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Accounts Payable | Redwood Inference
